evidence: spectrum_integral = true with 5 distinct eigenvalues (495, 45, 1, -9, -165), consistent with a Kneser graph K(n,4) association scheme
largest eigenvalue 495 has multiplicity 1; the smallest is -165

reply.analysis: Proven: beta = 455 for the 1820-receiver graph (hypothesised Kneser K(16,4)). Lower bound: an independent set of size 455, checked. Upper bound: linear code M = I + A over F_2 of length 455, with code_fits, factorization and decoding checks all true. One code was tried. Baselines: cpsat_alpha reached 455 but did not prove it in about 123 s; cpsat_cover found no value; frac_cover gave 1800 unproven; f2_minrank_sat gave only lower 454 in 1.2 s. kushagra_agent proved the same exact 455 in 1.90 s, while this agent took 31.4 s wall time (compute 0.99 s, LLM 30.4 s). Same accuracy, about 16x slower than kushagra_agent, all due to LLM time. Nothing suspicious.
